Shinku's twin sister. She never leaves someone alone if she finds that the child is in trouble. Always has a smile on her face. Her specialty, or belief, is to bring a smile to someone's face. Quite energetic, despite her petite body. She's in love with her childhood friend Yuuma.

Nikaidou Ai (along with Nikaidou Sora) are actually two parts of the soul of the "original" Haku who was the mother of the Ren who took Kanoue Yuuma's name. Ai's soul is the continuation of Haku's soul after leaving her bad memories behind and reincarnating.

今は最果ての古書店に戻り、管理者であるユウマと共に、今を生きる大切な命たちを遠く見守っている。
でも時々かわいい誰かを贔屓したくて、古書店から抜け出してくることもある。

困った子を見つけたら放っておけない。 いつでも笑顔で、特技――というか信念は、人を笑顔にすること。

A young man who instinctively comes to the aid of others whenever he is asked for help. He is rather careless with the use of his healing power, despite the cost to his memories, and is only thanks to Shinku's constant reminder to write in his special "diary" that he is able to retain his memories.
He frequently dreams of a blue sky from which white feathers fall and a voice that calls to him: - "Please... please save us."
He is a strong believer in the necessity of free will, especially when it comes to his "job" as a "nigashiya".

Kanoue Yuuma is actually a name he borrowed from someone else in order to get close to Shinku; in Irotoridori no Hikari, his real name is revealed to be Ren (レン). His true identity is that of the god who watches over all the worlds, although he is unaware of this. Yuuma is the author of "Irotoridori no Sekai", a world he created and lives in for the sole purpose of granting Shinku's wishes.
Edited from Clephas' review
今作の主人公。
作家業を営むもスランプ気味。昔の感覚を取り戻したいと、学生寮、嵐山荘で“合宿”という名の現実逃避に入る。
娘の青空を溺愛している。自分は父親なのだから娘とキスしても何の問題もないはずだ――と、親バカを通り越して少し危ない。
が、それも真紅に「いいかげんにしろ」と怒られたいだけなのかもしれない。
そんなふうにふざけあえる毎日の中にあって、しかし仕事は遅々として進まないのだった。
主人公。

それは手を触れるだけで、《他者の負傷を完全に治癒してしまえる力》。
しかしその力には大きな代償があって……。
明るい性格だが少々面倒くさがり。年下に対して面倒見のいい面もある。

特技は料理と物忘れ。
「願いが叶えば、俺たちはもう、いまみたいに一緒には居られなくなる」

The 'Magician' whom only Yuuma can see. She is very much the serious, intellectual type, but at the same time a passionately caring individual. She has an aversion to 'ecchi' things as well as an endless hunger for pancakes. She continually reminds Yuuma to write in his diary in order to retain his memories from day to day, and whenever he uses his power, she reminds him of its cost, desperately wanting him to care for himself as well as those he heals.

A cheerful girl who works hard to make money for a reason she refuses to explain. She has a habit of apologizing for the least of things, and her gratitude when given something (such as food) is far out of proportion with what the gift is actually worth. Oddly, despite her need for money, she refuses to borrow money from Yuuma or anyone else, saying that "there is no meaning if I don't earn it on my own".

A girl who used to be Mio's classmate when they were young.
Her teacher and classmates bullied her. One day she obtained a special power, which she used to kill those who bullied her.

The "real" Kisaragi Mio from Kazatsugahama and Yuuma's real childhood friend. After her parents were murdered, she met Yuuma. However, when she and Yuuma went to Arashiyama-sou to solve Yuuma's memory issues, she accidentally ended up in a parallel universe, where her parents are still alive. The Mio from the parallel universe agreed to switch worlds for one week, so that Mio could spend some more time with her parents. However after one week, the "watashi" Mio never let the other (current) Mio return, until she avenged her real parents' deaths.
